verdict.rationale: Railway documents a built-in, chat-based Railway Agent inside the dashboard that operates the platform on the user's behalf. It can create and configure services, set variables, diagnose failed deployments (including automatically), and open pull requests with fixes. It also extends to Slack/Discord mentions and MCP connectors such as Linear tickets. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent's delegation quality (all evidence is vendor docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Railway Agent is a chat-based AI assistant built into the Railway dashboard. It can operate the platform on your behalf: creating and configuring services, inspecting deployments, diagnosing failures, and opening pull requests to fix broken builds.
Create services, set variables, connect databases, wire up networking, and adjust resource limits.
When a deployment fails, the agent can automatically investigate.
Ask it why a deploy broke and it can pull the Sentry issue, or hand it a Linear ticket to work from.
